EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 441 December 17, 1974
DESIGNATING THE NATIONAL IRRIGATION ADMINISTRATION AS THE IMPLEMENTING
AGENCY FOR THE JALAUR RIVER IRRIGATION PROJECT IN ILOILO
WHEREAS, the Jalaur River Irrigation Project is designed to provide dependable water supply critical for the
country's production program;
WHEREAS, a project study for the Jalaur River Irrigation Project has already been made and found
economically viable;
WHEREAS, the National Irrigation Administration (NIA) is a government agency involved in the execution
of the national irrigation projects and as such has the necessary experience expertise required for the speedy
and successful implementation of irrigation projects;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Republic of the Philippines, by virtue
of the powers vested in me by the Constitution, do hereby designate the National Irrigation Administration
(NIA) as the Implementing Agency for the Jalaur River Irrigation Project.
As such, the NIA shall have the following functions:
1. To ensure the early and successful implementation and completion of the project.
2. To negotiate with and receive from the financing institutions loans to finance the project;
3. To coordinate with the National Water Resources Council (NWRC) in the planning and supervision of this
4. To recommend to the President through the NWRC, policies, rules and regulations that will govern the
operation of the project;
5. To submit quarterly progress reports to the President.
All departments, bureaus, offices, agencies and instrumentalities of government are hereby enjoined cooperate
with and assist the NIA in the performance assigned tasks, to ensure the early and successful implementation
of the project.
This Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 17th day of December, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-four.
